questions.markdown:
Find the Fourier series expansion of the function

$$
f(x)=x-x^2,
-1\le x\le 1,
f(x+2)=f(x).
$$

Obtain the half-range Fourier cosine series expansion of

$$
f(x)=x(\pi-x),\ 0\le x\le \pi.
$$

Find the constant term and first sine and cosine terms of the Fourier series expansion of $y$ from the following data.

| $x$ | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| $y$ | 9 | 18 | 24 | 28 | 26 | 20 |

questions.markdown:
Solve the system of equations

$$
x+y-z=4,\qquad x-2y+3z=-6,\qquad 2x+3y+z=7
$$

by the LU decomposition method.

Find the Cholesky decomposition of the matrix

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}4&2&6\\2&10&9\\6&9&14\end{bmatrix}.
$$

Find a singular value decomposition of the matrix

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}-4&-7\\1&4\end{bmatrix}.
$$

Let $W$ be the subspace of $\mathbb{R}^4$ spanned by the set of vectors

$$
\{(1,1,2,4),(2,-1,-5,2),(1,-1,-4,0),(2,1,1,6)\}.
$$

 Find a basis and the dimension of $W$.

Consider the following subspaces of $\mathbb{R}^3$.

$$
U=\operatorname{Span}\{(1,0,1),(0,1,1)\} \quad \text{and} \quad W=\operatorname{Span}\{(1,1,0),(1,2,1)\}.
$$

 Find the dimension of $U+W$ and $U\cap W$.

Let $T:\mathbb{R}^3\to\mathbb{R}^2$ be a linear transformation defined by

$$
T(x,y,z)=(x-y-2z,-x+2y+3z).
$$

Find a basis and the dimension of

(i) Kernel of $T$

(ii) Image of $T$.

Find the change of basis matrix $P$ from

$$
B=\{(1,2,1),(2,3,3),(3,7,1)\}
$$

to the basis

$$
B'=\{(3,1,4),(5,2,1),(1,1,-6)\}
$$

in $\mathbb{R}^3$. Hence write down the change of basis matrix from $B'$ to $B$.

questions.markdown:
Let $V$ be the vector space of all the polynomials over $\mathbb{R}$ with the inner product

$$
\langle p(x),q(x)\rangle=\int_a^b p(x)q(x)\,dx.
$$

 

Determine the cosine of the angle between the polynomials

$$
p(x)=x^3-x \quad \text{and} \quad q(x)=x^2+x
$$

in $[-1,1]$.

Find an orthonormal basis for the orthogonal complement of the vector

$$
u=(1,1,0,1).
$$
